{{Infobox organization |name=Acme Corporation |logo=Dopeskillz_trimmed_2017.jpg |founder={{player|eb|flag=de}} |founded=2019 |members={{player|eb|flag=de}}, {{player|eb|flag=de}}, {{player|eb|flag=de}} |type=General Asholery }} This Infobox is designed to give basic information about an organization of people. ===Parameters=== * '''name''' = Organization name * '''logo''' = (optional) Logo * '''founder''' = (optional) Name of founder with flag * '''founded''' = (optional) Year of inception * '''members''' = (optional) Members of the organization * '''type''' = (optional) Type of organization === Blank template === You can copy the code snippet below and fill in the parameters to customize this Infobox. If any parameter doesn't apply, leave it blank and that line will not appear in the Infobox. 
{{Infobox map
|name=
|founder=
|founded=
|members=
|logo=
|type=
}}
=== Example === The code below created the Infobox on this page. 
{{Infobox organization
|name=Acme Corporation
|logo=Dopeskillz_trimmed_2017.jpg
|founder={{player|eb|flag=de}}
|founded=2019
|members={{player|eb|flag=de}}, {{player|eb|flag=de}}, {{player|eb|flag=de}}
|type=General Asholery
}}
